ads.primary: Six days north from Kansas City or Omaha: Osawatomie, Falls Park, the Corn Palace and the Missouri, then west across North Dakota to Medora, the Badlands and the new Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library.

ads.name: The Roosevelt Triangle
ads.primary: Mount Rushmore, Yellowstone and the North Dakota Badlands: three corners of one big Western road trip. In the Badlands corner is Medora, a real Western town most people haven't found yet, with bison, wild horses and the new Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library.

ads.name: Deep Time: a dinosaur road trip
ads.primary: A dinosaur road trip across North Dakota: petrified trees in the national park at Medora, mounted dinosaurs in Dickinson, a mummified Edmontosaurus in Bismarck and a public dig. Start at the new Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library in Medora.

ads.name: Five presidents, one road trip
ads.primary: Five presidents, one road trip: the Eisenhower, Truman, Lincoln and Hoover presidential libraries, ending at the new Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library in Medora, a small Old West town in the North Dakota Badlands.

campaigns.name: DESTINATION: Trade screens for skies (family trips)
campaigns.optimization: Landing page views on /visit and the family itineraries
campaigns.why: The parent planning the summer trip wants everyone to have fun and actually be together. Medora delivers that without being told: bison from the back seat, a trail ride, steaks cooked on pitchforks, a musical under the stars, a campfire story inside the Library. The ads show those moments; they never mention phones or who is planning.
